body.summary: At Lumon Industries, employees undergo a surgical procedure that splits their memory between a work self (the 'innie') and an outside self (the 'outie'), so neither remembers the other's life. Mark Scout, a widower who chose severance to escape grief over his wife Gemma, leads the Macrodata Refinement team on the severed floor, where numbers must be sorted into bins by feel. New hire Helly R. resists the arrangement violently, and the team's discovery of the outside world through the Overtime Contingency leads to a rebellion; ||the season ends with the innies briefly surfacing outside, Mark learning his wife may still be alive as Ms. Casey, and Helly revealing herself as Helena Eagan, an heir to the company.||

arcs.summary: Helly refuses severance, attempts escape and self-harm, and is forced through the Break Room until she accepts the work.
Mark investigates Petey's reintegration and death, and begins to suspect the company's reach into his own life.
The team discovers the Overtime Contingency and uses it to surface their innies outside Lumon.
Irving and Burt's cross-department romance is ended by Burt's retirement.
Dylan learns his outie has a family and meets his wife in the visitation room.

notable_scenes.summary: Helly's first attempt to leave, ending with her suspended in the stairwell doorway.
The team watches Helly's orientation video and learns the rules of the severed floor.
Petey's funeral and Mark's discovery of the map and photo.
The MDR team stages a waffle party and Dylan triggers the Overtime Contingency.
Mark's innie surfaces at Ricken's reading and shouts about Gemma.
Helly's outie is revealed as Helena Eagan at the gala.
Ms. Casey is sent to the testing floor after her final wellness session with Mark.
